description: This file defines classes and functions related to the internal configuration management of Playwright test runner, including classes for full configuration and project internal configuration, as well as utility functions for resolving scripts, reporters, and dependencies.

classes.name: FullConfigInternal
classes.description: Represents the internal full configuration for Playwright, including project setup, plugins, and CLI overrides.

classes.name: FullProjectInternal
classes.description: Represents the internal configuration for a specific project within the Playwright test setup.

methods.name: takeFirst
methods.description: Utility function to return the first defined argument among its parameters.

methods.name: pathResolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative path against a base directory.

methods.name: resolveReporters
methods.description: Resolves reporter configurations into a standardized format.

methods.name: resolveWorkers
methods.description: Converts a string or number into a worker count, supporting percentages.

methods.name: resolveProjectDependencies
methods.description: Resolves project dependencies and teardowns, ensuring correctness.

methods.name: toReporters
methods.description: Converts reporter configuration into an array of reporter descriptions.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique project ID assigned internally.
